argument: The first view must read as one negative-space field before it reads as twenty-four sites. Unequal aperture scale, central quiet, and asymmetric return axes must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the field must leave v046's folded cadence, v047's absence arch, and v048's pressure shell. It should read as stored attention in openings, not a particle demo.

The visitor must attend to the lit witness and withdraw toward a different returned witness. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the return control must provide equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.
An incomplete hold, repeated witness, wrong witness, and wrong reply must leave every aperture exact. Only a valid return may alter the field.
The watched entry must become an actual absence in the field, not a label or halo. The next witness must move to the returned site as a consequence of the same event.
A returned attention must re-produce the whole arrangement. A local hole or cursor response is insufficient; most sites must change in their opening, echo, or attention state.
Four returns must compound in one field. Lift must reconstruct the exact prior state, and release must return to the deterministic quiet field.
The field, witness readout, controls, and keyboard path must remain visible and reachable at 320px and 390px without horizontal overflow or hover dependency.
Native Canvas 2D apertures, counter-axis, deterministic state, and the capability boundary are the medium. No imported model, image, font, or p5 library may carry the work.

little-critters is translated from situated proximity and reciprocal looking into collective negative-space memory. Animals, faces, paper style, head-turning, source composition, source code, and surface vocabulary are refused.
v049 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal memory, shape vocabulary, and medium: flat apertures and withdrawal replace the mesh, route shell, and discrete social arch.
Delete v049 if attention is cursor decoration, only one aperture changes, return order is cosmetic, memory resets, lift is inexact, or the blind field reads as a generic constellation.
